GOV-F-003-S127.title: Brain Lock Expiry Recovery and Reacquisition Logic
GOV-F-003-S127.description: Implement recovery logic that detects expired locks and safely allows new ownership acquisition. Ensure stale locks are ignored, prevent race conditions during reacquisition, and enforce atomic compare-and-set semantics.

GOV-F-003-S128.title: Brain Lock End-to-End Integration and Concurrency Tests
GOV-F-003-S128.description: Create integration tests simulating concurrent lock acquisition, TTL expiration, heartbeat renewal, and recovery scenarios. Validate no double-ownership, correct expiration handling, and system stability under contention.
